charter_values_notes: The framework looks beyond product cycles via annual systemic reviews and expanding model capabilities, but its cadence is yearly and deployment-focused rather than century-scale. It prioritizes truth-seeking and anti-deception training and documents risks, yet public disclosure is selective and incident reporting is mainly legal. Residual risk can be accepted, but only with safety margins, layered safeguards, tiered release, and shutdown authority, so tolerance is low. Decision rights and full capabilities stay concentrated with xAI, trusted partners, and governments, with anti-proliferation controls outweighing limited consultation and regulatory accountability.
